en:
## New Features

- MCP fine-grained permissions: refactored from allow/ask/deny to readOnly/readWrite/ask/deny, subagents now filter available MCP tools by permission level
- Edit message button: bottom send button in NarratorPanel reuses as "Save & Regenerate" during message editing
- Terminal auxiliary keys: arrow keys now support long-press repeat
- Subagent MCP tools: all subagent types (including custom) can access MCP tools when permissions allow

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed MCP ask permission bypassing dontAsk mode, now correctly denies instead of prompting
- Legacy MCP allow config auto-migrates to readWrite on settings load and API input
- Narrator list mobile layout: archive button moved to title row, fixed overflow

## Improvements

- Relaxed model identifier validation to support more provider formats
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- MCP 细粒度权限：从 allow/ask/deny 三级重构为 readOnly/readWrite/ask/deny 四级，子代理按权限级别过滤可用 MCP 工具
- 编辑消息按钮：叙述者面板底部发送按钮在编辑消息时复用为"保存并重新生成"
- 终端辅助键：方向键支持长按重复发送
- 子代理 MCP 工具：所有子代理类型（含自定义）在权限允许时可访问 MCP 工具

## 修复

- 修复 MCP ask 权限在 dontAsk 模式下仍然弹出审批的问题，现在正确拒绝
- 旧 MCP allow 配置在 settings 加载和 API 输入时自动迁移为 readWrite
- 叙述者列表移动端布局：归档按钮移至标题行，修复溢出问题

## 改进

- 放宽模型标识符校验以支持更多 provider 格式
